description: This file serves as the entry point for a React web application, where it initializes React's rendering process by attaching the main App component to the DOM element with id 'root'. It also imports necessary dependencies such as React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for concurrent rendering in the DOM element with specified id.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root.
